Methodology: Counts describe only this fixed versioned24-row engineering inventory. No percentage or whole-NIF/whole-loader compatibility total is defined. Accepted-scoped means only the explicitly bounded done criterion has accepted evidence; local-tests-only/source-only/missing cannot be promoted by MFA presence. InMain is source presence at SnapshotMainCommit,not same-head CI or feature completion. RemainingOrBlockers include explicitly excluded extensions even when a scoped milestone is met.

MfaAccounting.Method: Current MFA counts come from the separate canonical API report, never from this inventory.

full.Scope: 7438/0 Windows full suite,11 integrations,2 packages,12 normal children; not every NIF API

windows-original.Scope: 34 exact rows across map-size/reference reviewed and ordinary routes

linux.Scope: 68 callback comparisons,16 managed counts,3 loader and3 destructor controls,50 normal receipts

source-chain.Scope: Tested Linux source to final candidate source equivalence; no execution inferred

contract.Scope: Bounded map-size/reference contracts and stated exclusions

main-build.Scope: Actual integrated Main test-project build; no general semantic proof

main-focus.Scope: Actual integrated focused checks; retain declared count/scope

Entries.Title: Ordinary and reviewed NIF admission
Entries.Scope: Admitted synchronous fixtures; ordinary host loading and optional reviewed hash admission remain separate.
Entries.DoneCriterion: On admitted x64 routes load valid fixtures and retain raw native error controls without conflating fixture and bridge producer identities.
RemainingOrBlockers: Complete OTP load failure text/error_info partition and every native dependency graph are not established.

Entries.Title: Native entry ABI admission
Entries.Scope: Fixed OTP2.18 entry layout,beam.vanilla,zero function flags and x64 native widths.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Independently exercise every admitted entry field and rejected version/layout/function-metadata branch,including MinimumErts/ResourceInitSize applicability.
RemainingOrBlockers: EntryReader fixes2.18; fields existing in a struct are not implemented feature support. Wider entry versions/options and full minimum-ERTS/resource-field policy remain open.

Entries.Title: Image-owned installation and dispatch
Entries.Scope: Function declarations,source/BEAM caller identity,reservations and image-specific NIF bindings.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Validate commit/abort,exact caller/current-old image routing,declared function constraints and quiescent dispatch across all admitted entries.
RemainingOrBlockers: Host regression evidence is not a full OTP upgrade/reload or arbitrary stale-code contract proof.

Entries.Title: Synchronous native call and exception boundary
Entries.Scope: A normal native frame owns callback scope,environment,pending exception and return-term conversion.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Exercise all pending-exception/return precedence,argument-count/context and unwinding branches with valid ABI calls.
RemainingOrBlockers: No interruption of arbitrary native code; native memory corruption is not contained like an Erlang exception. Async and dirty execution are separate units.

Entries.Title: Bound term handles and provenance
Entries.Scope: Opaque managed-model handles with environment/runtime ownership and call-thread validity.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Prove handle admission,copy,clear/dispose and cross-runtime/thread partitions with no expired handle reuse.
RemainingOrBlockers: Handles differ from BEAM tagged terms and have a finite signed-long process-wide ceiling. Invalid pointers/expired or unsynchronized handles are outside native crash parity.

Entries.Title: Native allocation ownership and reallocation
Entries.Scope: Owned native buffers,requested/backing extent accounting and explicit reviewed reallocation profile.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Validate real allocation/reallocation/free histories,failed-init/unload containment and accounting on each admitted reallocation route.
RemainingOrBlockers: Reallocation remains profile/platform bounded; arbitrary allocator ownership mixing and OOM/native-fault parity are not accepted.

Entries.Title: Independent environments and copying
Entries.Scope: alloc_env/free_env/clear_env/make_copy for synchronized use,with allocator bound to the owning runtime.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Observe original/native/managed copy-clear-free lifetime and two-runtime joined foreign allocation ownership without a global-runtime fallback.
RemainingOrBlockers: Callers must synchronize independent environments and stop workers before unload. Shared unsynchronized access and invalid environments are excluded.

Entries.Title: Native binary descriptor and storage lifetime
Entries.Scope: Implemented inspect/allocate/reallocate/release/make/subbinary callbacks and owned storage in the currently wired Windows surface.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Validate descriptor/copy/pending-node ownership,mutation and release partitions and publish equivalent admitted-platform callback matrices.
RemainingOrBlockers: Linux bridge does not expose the full Windows binary callback surface. Zero-copy BEAM layout/GC identity and every descriptor invalid-use branch are not claimed.

Entries.Title: Native numeric marshalling
Entries.Scope: Implemented integer/float get/make callback families using actual LLP64/LP64 widths.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Exercise finite/range/type/overflow branches for every wired numeric callback on both ABIs against pinned original observations.
RemainingOrBlockers: Width observations are accepted; all numeric callback contracts are not independently complete merely because widths match.

Entries.Title: Sequence,atom,string and type callbacks
Entries.Scope: Wired predicates,list-cell,tuple/list constructors and Windows atom/string/tuple access.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Close each admitted callback type/encoding/length/output/lifetime branch and document platform matrix.
RemainingOrBlockers: Platform callback surfaces differ; Latin1/string limits and variadic item bounds are explicit adaptations. Not every OTP term callback is present.

Entries.Title: Native comparison and identity
Entries.Scope: Windows slots15/16 use managed term ordering/exact identity and owned handle resolution.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Publish full supported term-domain comparisons and expose/prove equivalent Linux callbacks before cross-platform completion.
RemainingOrBlockers: Linux comparison slots15/16 remain pending. Representation and floating/reference ownership boundaries must remain explicit.

Entries.Title: Reference generation
Entries.Scope: enif_make_ref using environment runtime and finite language reference generator; Windows slot28.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Close valid-environment reference identity,node/type,generator-boundary,copy/lifetime and joined two-runtime branches with pinned observations.
RemainingOrBlockers: Finite reference domain/generator and separate opaque-handle capacity remain documented. MakeRef(NULL),expired pointers and exact cross-VM raw words are excluded.

Entries.Title: Map cardinality
Entries.Scope: enif_get_map_size/Windows slot109 for admitted static MapTerm values,including independent/retained owner resolution.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Close success/cardinality/canary/nonmap-no-write/env-independent/joined-foreign/later-retained valid-use branches against pinned OTP.
RemainingOrBlockers: Future pending native map nodes are not preapproved. Successful-map NULL-output writes and expired/unsynchronized pointers are outside parity.

Entries.Title: Linux namespace and raw path loader controls
Entries.Scope: Per-runtime NEWLM bridge/allocator/reader;ordered capsule dependencies; reviewed descriptors and ordinary raw paths.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Retain distinct runtime ownership and exact fixture bytes; pass the declared origin/spaces/read-only,bare-name and missing-dependency controls on glibc x64.
RemainingOrBlockers: Not a proof for every SONAME/versioned/transitive/dlopen dependency graph,namespace/TLS exhaustion or hidden libc behavior. No base-copy path rewrite is in Main.

Entries.Title: Windows initializer callback table
Entries.Scope: LoadLibrary-based ordinary/reviewed image loading and per-image initializer callback slots.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Validate ABI table lifetime,required wired slots and admitted path/error partitions on Windows x64 with native callback fixtures.
RemainingOrBlockers: Zero-filled unwired slots are unsupported callbacks,not a complete OTP180-slot implementation. DLL dependency and invalid pointer behavior remain bounded.

Entries.Title: Quiescent unload and image retirement
Entries.Scope: Drain admitted calls,invoke unload and finish target destructors before reclaiming owned allocations/callback storage.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Complete normal image retirement/runtime disposal after joined native workers on both admitted x64 routes,with real cleanup receipts.
RemainingOrBlockers: This unit requires joined workers. Arbitrary background callbacks,active resource destructors and hot upgrades are not accepted by these receipts.

Entries.Title: Joined native worker and selected TLS destructors
Entries.Scope: Eight base-libc provider bridges on NEWLM: create/join,key create/delete,get/set-specific,__cxa_thread_atexit_impl,pthread_exit.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Actual witnesses resolve declared wrappers; callback workers join; C++ and pthread TLS destructor probes each return1111 for normal return and explicit exit with exact counters.
RemainingOrBlockers: getspecific is resolved but its positive call count is zero in the current probe. Cancellation,hidden libc calls,arbitrary C++ TLS/DSO unload and unjoined workers remain unverified; no whole-pthread claim.

Entries.Title: NIF resources and resource types
Entries.Scope: Resource type creation,takeover,resource terms/refcounts/destructors/GC integration.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Implement resource ownership and GC/destructor/takeover contracts and obtain original platform/lifetime comparisons.
RemainingOrBlockers: ResourceInitSize struct field is metadata only; no resource API/GC implementation found in the inspected native callback surface.

Entries.Title: Dirty native scheduler execution
Entries.Scope: CPU/IO dirty flags,scheduling and process/scheduler interaction.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Admit intended dirty flags and prove scheduler responsiveness,call ownership,cancellation/halt and error behavior with genuine fixtures.
RemainingOrBlockers: Nonzero function Flags currently rejected. General Task-based runtime scheduling is not dirty-NIF support.

Entries.Title: Async native work and IO notifications
Entries.Scope: Continuation/scheduled NIFs,native send/select/monitor and async ownership handoff.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Define and implement the selected async API contracts,environment/resource ownership and completion/cancellation/shutdown tests.
RemainingOrBlockers: No enif_schedule_nif/enif_select/enif_send bridge implementation found. Async loader/disposal methods do not implement these APIs.

Entries.Title: Native reload and code upgrade
Entries.Scope: Native entry Reload/Upgrade callbacks,old/new priv_data and code/resource takeover.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Implement supported hot upgrade/reload transactions and prove rollback/old-code/resource/native-call lifetime semantics.
RemainingOrBlockers: Reload and Upgrade fields exist but admission explicitly rejects Reload/UpgradeUnsupported. Ordinary load/unload is not upgrade support.

Entries.Title: Native map construction,mutation and iteration
Entries.Scope: Native map creation,put/update/remove and iteration beyond static MapTerm cardinality.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Implement and bind the selected native map mutation/iterator family; prove pending map ownership,copy/materialization and error/lifetime contracts.
RemainingOrBlockers: Slots110-114 are pending; cardinality of static MapTerm values does not implement native map construction or iterator state.

Entries.Title: Additional native ABI/platform routes
Entries.Scope: ARM64,32-bit,macOS,musl and other unsupported native platform layouts.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Explicitly admit each target ABI,build actual native fixtures and establish ownership/lifetime/platform error parity.
RemainingOrBlockers: Current accepted profile is Windows/glibc Linux x64. Managed-code portability does not prove native ABI portability.

Entries.Title: Failed-close containment and retained roots
Entries.Scope: Source-reviewed quarantine keeps owner,callbacks,allocations and namespace leases alive after actual close failure.
Entries.DoneCriterion: Obtain bounded injected/actual failed-close receipts proving roots remain live,no premature reclaim and no false successful disposal across repeated failure.
RemainingOrBlockers: Normal cleanup receipts do not execute failed-dlclose branches. Quarantine intentionally retains storage and is not evidence of successful release or native crash containment.
